purpose: Teach: 山上/川本/和泉/玉田/三枝/寺田/岩井/しのぎ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で山上の演説覚えたな
lines.en: Riku—you memorized that Yamagami speech in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing accusation. Leans in slightly. Not serious, but watching for his reaction. Quick delivery with a hint of a smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの川本と話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were talking to Kawamoto from the next class over, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with the same energy. Quick counterattack. Half-smile. Doesn't look away—meeting her teasing at the same level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、和泉先輩を尊敬してたな
lines.style: Softer now, more genuine curiosity underneath the tease. Testing whether he'll admit it. Slower pace, watching his face.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、玉田おじさんと挨拶してたな、桜
lines.en: You were saying hello to Tamada-san the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Not accusatory—more like he's noticed something and is turning it back on her. Slight uptick of knowing amusement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの三枝と仲良いな
lines.en: Riku—you and Saegusa from the next class are pretty close, aren't you?
lines.style: Softer, more direct. The teasing is gentler now. Seeking confirmation. Slight pause before the question, like she's picking her words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾の寺田先生厳しかったな、桜
lines.en: Your cram school teacher Terada was really harsh on you, wasn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry observation with a hint of sympathy. Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight tilt of the head—he's noticed it bothered her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの岩井と話してたな
lines.en: Riku—you were talking with Iwai from the next class, weren't you?
lines.style: Back to teasing, but with a knowing undertone. Quick and light, but her eyes are tracking his reaction. Playful but real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お小遣いのしのぎ、つまりやりくり大変だったな、桜
lines.en: Managing your allowance was tough for you these days, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry, gentle close. Quieter than before. He's wrapped up his observations. Slight trailing-off, like he's leaving room for her to respond if she wants to.
